name: Bicep: Redis Cache non-SSL port enabled
attack_scenario: a network attacker sniffs or connects to the plaintext 6379 port and reads or injects cached session tokens, credentials, and application data with no TLS in the way
negative_test_hint: deploy a template with "enableNonSslPort: true" and assert the policy check rejects it and the plaintext port 6379 is not reachable

exemplar.explanation: On Microsoft.Cache/Redis, enableNonSslPort:true opens the cleartext Redis port 6379 alongside the TLS port 6380, so clients (and any on-path attacker) can talk to the cache without encryption. CIS Azure and Microsoft guidance require SSL-only access (non-SSL port disabled).
